basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 23-year-old graphic designer from Austin, Texas. I've recently joined Reddit to connect with people who share my love for streetwear and design. I enjoy exploring urban art and have a keen interest in digital illustrations. When I'm not working on my latest design project, you can find me binge-watching dark TV series or searching for the next big trend in fashion. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM CST. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends with friends at local art events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from the University of Texas. Most of my expertise comes from spending countless hours on design software and participating in online communities focused on art and fashion. I'm self-taught in digital illustration, and I frequently attend workshops to improve my skills.
